newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NANTES MAY REPLACE ONE ARGENTINE WITH ANOTHER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NANTES MAY REPLACE ONE ARGENTINE WITH ANOTHER.

text.p: Nantes have put Argentine striker Javier Mazzoni on the transfer list and could go one step better by signing his international compatriot Sebastian Rambert from Boca Juniors.
Mazzoni, a disappointment since signing from Independiente for 10 million francs ($2 million) last year, went on the transfer list on Wednesday, a club statement said.
The big 25-year-old striker scored one goal in 19 first division games, mostly as a substitute, last season.
Nantes, 1995 French champions, have made an offer to Boca for Rambert, who like Mazzoni began his career at Independiente and has eight Argentina caps.
"The solution could be a loan or a definitive transfer to South America where contacts are under way," Nantes' sporting director Robert Budzynski said.
Nantes, short of striking power after the departure of Japhet N'Doram to Monaco, Claude Makelele to Marseille and Nenad Bjekovic to Chateauroux, are hoping to make a quick signing.
If it is made by August 15, they will retain the right to sign one other player, termed a "joker", during the season.
Rambert has joint nationality like his late father Angel, a France international in the 1960s.
Nantes have signed several Argentines in the past including 1986 World Cup midfielder Jorge Burruchaga, also from Independiente.
